# Godot MCP Pro CSharp — LLM Reference

> MCP server running inside the Godot 4 editor. 239 tools across 39 categories.
> No Node.js required. Self-contained C# with Streamable HTTP + stdio bridge.

## Architecture

```
AI Assistant ──stdio──> Bridge (C# console) ──HTTP:65001──> Godot Editor Plugin
AI Assistant ──HTTP──> Godot Editor Plugin (direct)
Editor Plugin ──file IPC──> Running Game (3 autoload services)
```

- All mutations through EditorUndoRedoManager (Ctrl+Z works)
- Smart type parsing: "Vector2(x,y)", "#ff0000", "Color(r,g,b,a)", res:// paths
- v1.14 safety model: open-scene write guards (-32009), dry_run-by-default for cross_scene_set_property

## Error Codes

| Code | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| -32000 | Generic error / no scene / no game running |
| -32001 | Not found |
| -32002 | Script compilation failed |
| -32009 | Conflict (file open in editor, use force=true) |
| -32601 | Method not found |
| -32602 | Invalid parameters |
| -32603 | Internal error |

## Requirements

- Godot 4.4+ with .NET support
- .NET 8.0 SDK
- Any MCP-compatible client (Claude Code, Cursor, Cline, etc.)

## Modes

| Mode | Tools | Flag |
|------|-------|------|
| Full | 239 | (default) |
| 3D | 210 | --3d |
| Lite | 124 | --lite |
| Minimal | 86 | --minimal |
